heading: Effect on existing laws
lead: The provisions of previous Acts of Congress not inconsistent with the provisions of this subchapter shall remain in full force and effect.

notes.text: Construction With Other LawsAct Aug. 4, 1939, ch. 418, § 18, 53 Stat. 1198, provided that: “Nothing in this Act [see section 485k of this title] shall be construed to amend the Boulder Canyon Project Act (45 Stat. 1057), as amended [section 617 et seq. of this title].”
